stage0074_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$甲児$$
「I was... beaten by that $$ハーデス$$... and then...」

stage0074_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$甲児$$
「Who are you... just who are you...!?」

stage0074_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
???
「Me?
　I am all-knowing and all-powerful,
　the one who protects and guides you...」

stage0074_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「My name is $$ゼウス$$.
　But in truth, my true form is Z Mazinger.」

stage0074_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「This is the space between dimensions...
　a universe beyond time and space.」

stage0074_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$甲児$$
「Why would I be in a place like that...」

stage0074_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「The power of will moves all things.
　Even space and time itself.」

stage0074_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「And so you and I could meet like this.
　I am glad for our reunion.」

stage0074_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Thousands of years ago... we, the gods
　of Olympus, needed a forward base
　to fight $$バアル$$...」

stage0074_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Though at the galaxy's edge, we descended
　on a star brimming with 《$$オリジン・ロー$$》,
　that is, Earth.」

stage0074_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$オリジン・ロー$$...
　You mean $$次元力$$...」

stage0074_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Primitive though they were, the people
　of Mycenae we descended upon held a love
　and courage the gods had forgotten.」

stage0074_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「I came to love humans such as these,
　and dreamed that one day these young brothers
　would awaken to truth and run the stars with me.」

stage0074_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「But the other gods did not feel the same.」

stage0074_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「They wished to claim Earth as their own,
　and with its overflowing $$オリジン・ロー$$,
　win the war among the gods.」

stage0074_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「I could not forgive that...
　And so I fought $$ハーデス$$'s legion.」

stage0074_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$甲児$$
「Could it be... the illusion Kedora showed me was...」

stage0074_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「That was no illusion.
　It truly happened.」

stage0074_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「No wonder.
　Your memories were sealed away
　when you crossed through space and time.」

stage0074_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「But it is fact. In an instant, you and
　the armor of Kurogane crossed space and time,
　appearing where $$ハーデス$$ and I fought our final battle.」

stage0074_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Caught in $$ハーデス$$'s scheme, alone and cornered,
　you saved me in the name of justice.」

stage0074_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「With your help I won that victory,
　and sealed $$ハーデス$$ and his legion away there.」

stage0074_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$甲児$$
「So that's how the Mycenaean civilization fell...」

stage0074_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「And then, I sensed it,
　that far across time you were the one
　who would carry on my soul.」

stage0074_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「To help make that happen, I buried the arm
　severed in my fight with $$ハーデス$$ in the earth,
　then slept myself in the space between dimensions.」

stage0074_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$甲児$$
「So that's where Photon Energy and Chogokin Z
　came from, and how my $$マジンガーＺ$$
　was completed...」

stage0074_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「But $$ハーデス$$ and the others awoke to this world
　through the ritual of Isolde and Tristan.」

stage0074_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「That likely means the 12,000-year cycle
　is closing, and the decisive battle
　with $$バアル$$ is drawing near.」

stage0074_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$甲児$$
「Tell me, $$ゼウス$$!
　What is this 12,000-year cycle!?」

stage0074_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「It is too soon for you to know that.」

stage0074_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$甲児$$
「Is now really the time to say that!?」

stage0074_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$エタニティ・フラット$$ and $$バアル$$...!
　Our world might be
　on the verge of ending!」

stage0074_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$甲児$$
「Whether you're a god or whatever else,
　if all you do is watch from above,
　I will not forgive you!」

stage0074_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Heh... you do not fear me, a god.
　That is how it should be.」

stage0074_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「I cannot do that. The universe's truths
　are things you must grasp yourself.
　Without them, there is no evolution.」

stage0074_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Warrior.
　Tell me your name again.」

stage0074_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$兜甲児$$.
　And the robot you call the armor of Kurogane
　is named $$マジンガーＺ$$.」

stage0074_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「$$マジンガーＺ$$...
　A good name.」

stage0074_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「...Through my long sleep, my right arm too
　has been restored, but I still need more time
　to recover all my strength.」

stage0074_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Fight, $$兜甲児$$.
　$$ハーデス$$ means to remake this planet
　for his war against $$バアル$$.」

stage0074_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「He holds no regard for human life.
　If he feels humanity gets in his way,
　he'll wipe it out without hesitation.」

stage0074_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「What is it?
　Won't you say you'll stop $$ハーデス$$,
　as fiercely as you snapped at me before?」

stage0074_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Nothing is born from denial.
　Light is born where there is hope.」

stage0074_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Born and raised on that beautiful star,
　you are filled with the power of life.」

stage0074_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「You have what it takes to walk the path of light.
　Never abandon hope...」

stage0074_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$甲児$$
「Wait, $$ゼウス$$!
　There's still so much more I want to ask you!」

stage0074_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「You will learn it all in time.
　For you stand within the sun's radiance,
　at the threshold of evolution.」

stage0074_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「We will meet again, warrior of light.」

stage0074_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text: ～ Federation Far East Branch Base Salon ～

stage0074_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yeah...
　$$さやか$$'s been at his bedside the whole time.」

stage0074_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$カレン$$
「What's the captain and the others up to?」

stage0074_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Director $$大塚$$ and Commander $$レディ・アン$$
　have joined in, holding meeting after meeting
　about countermeasures for Mycenae.」

stage0074_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Their whereabouts are completely lost.
　No one's spotted them since.」

stage0074_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Then we should just leave them be.」

stage0074_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$シン$$
「Like hell we can do that!」

stage0074_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Those so-called gods are going to fight $$バアル$$, right?
　Then isn't that convenient for us?」

stage0074_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「If they break the Prison of Time, all the better,
　and if they fight $$バアル$$ on top of that,
　it's nothing but good news for us.」

stage0074_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But they think of humans
　as no better than insects.」

stage0074_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You must have felt it too, $$ギュネイ$$.
　Their arrogance, their cruelty.」

stage0074_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Even so, if they don't actively come at us,
　we can just ignore each other.」

stage0074_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Then what if they declare war on humanity?」

stage0074_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Then we'll deal with it then.
　It'll come down to being destroyed by $$バアル$$
　or destroyed by them.」

stage0074_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Then are you saying you can beat them?」

stage0074_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「What $$ギュネイ・ガス$$ says is reasonable.
　Their power is worthy of being called divine.」

stage0074_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$シン$$
「And isn't turning that around
　exactly what $$ゼロ$$, the man of miracles, does?」

stage0074_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Making a miracle happen needs proper groundwork.
　That's different from recklessly fighting
　against an overwhelming gap in strength.」

stage0074_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Does humanity have no choice but to perish...」

stage0074_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「That's leaving it up to the gods.
　All we can do is pray Mycenae overlooks us.」

stage0074_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Or should the whole Earth surrender to them
　and become servants of the gods?」

stage0074_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「If you've got something to say, say it.」

stage0074_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Look at reality.
　Get it through your head already that this
　isn't a situation spirit alone can turn around.」

stage0074_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$オードリー$$
（Even in a situation like this,
　you still try to struggle on...）

stage0074_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$静子$$
「$$つばさ$$...
　Are you sure you should be up?」

stage0074_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$つばさ$$
「...Truly, I wanted to keep sleeping
　like that forever...」

stage0074_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$タケル$$
「After hearing from the proprietress,
　$$竜馬$$ and I went to investigate,
　but no one was there anymore.」

stage0074_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$隼人$$
「I hear Dr. Kabuto wasn't in any condition
　to move on his own.」

stage0074_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$隼人$$
「That's not the only mystery.
　There's also Detective $$暗黒寺$$'s whereabouts.」

stage0074_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$タケル$$
「Dr. Kabuto, having uncovered $$あしゅら$$'s scheme,
　sent Detective $$暗黒寺$$ to $$くろがね屋$$
　to report it, and yet...」

stage0074_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「In the end he never showed up at $$くろがね屋$$,
　and his whereabouts remain unknown since...」

stage0074_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$カレン$$
「What is that no-good detective doing...!
　If he'd just done his job properly,
　none of this would have happened...!」

stage0074_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Stop it, $$カレン$$.
　It's a mistake we all made, failing to see
　through $$あしゅら$$'s scheme.」

stage0074_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That bastard... just when I thought
　he'd made up his mind, he goes and pulls
　something outrageous at the end.」

stage0074_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$タケル$$
「When the sky fills with ill-omened stars...
　he'd been waiting all this time for the ritual
　to revive the gods of Mycenae...」

stage0074_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$赤木$$
「Everyone, this is bad!
　Mycenae has appeared in Atami!」

stage0074_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$カレン$$
「Why a tourist spot like that!?」

stage0074_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$いぶき$$
「For now, it looks like the military's
　deployed, but...」

stage0074_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I doubt Federation forces can beat them.」

stage0074_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「That's just some tourist spot.
　If they showed up there, must be
　a whim of the gods.」

stage0074_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「If it's not strategically
　important, better to leave it be.」

stage0074_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Those things are gods...
　Not something humans can beat
　in a fight...」

stage0074_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$つばさ$$
「It's like a natural disaster.
　All we can do is hold our breath
　and wait for it to pass...」

stage0074_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$さやか$$
「The doctor says he should still
　be resting, but...」

stage0074_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$甲児$$
「If $c won't move, I'll go alone.」

stage0074_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Are you insane!?
　The enemy's a god!」

stage0074_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$甲児$$
「Don't kill me off on your own.」

stage0074_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$n
「My enemy is beyond human reckoning.
　I was ready to risk everything
　from the very start.」

stage0074_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$赤木$$
「Of course I'm going too!
　Sure, it's not a military site,
　but people live in Atami!」

stage0074_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$マリーダ$$...
　Even so, I'll keep saying it.」

stage0074_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（That's right, $$バナージ$$...
　That's your strength.）

stage0074_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Every last one of you's reckless.」

stage0074_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's not it.
　$$甲児$$, $n, me, all of us,
　none of us is going there to die.」

stage0074_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$ゼロ$$...
　Even if you try to stop us, we're going.」

stage0074_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's the answer I wanted to hear.」

stage0074_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$カレン$$
「You...why are you wearing
　a mask...!?」

stage0074_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「If the enemy is a god, then I too
　must be prepared - to throw away
　everything, that is.」

stage0074_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Our enemy calls itself a god!
　Then we shall become the ones
　who slay gods!」

stage0074_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$甲児$$
「Let's go, everyone!
　If they're humanity's enemy,
　we'll fight with all we've got!!」

stage0074_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「That's right, warrior!
　Draw out the power of light
　through your own will!」

stage0074_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Awaken the power of your
　black-iron armor once again!!」

stage0074_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$オズマ$$
「That was a victory on thin ice, alright.」

stage0074_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$竜馬$$
「But a win's a win.
　Thin ice or a close call, either way.」

stage0074_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$弁慶$$
「Might've been a small victory,
　but it seems to carry real weight.」

stage0074_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$つばさ$$
「What are you talking about!
　You and Mazinger are both a wreck!」

stage0074_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$つばさ$$
「...You've already flown
　right out of my hands, haven't you.」

stage0074_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$つばさ$$
「So what will you do now?」

stage0074_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Silly question, wasn't it.
　...Take care of the Kurogane Five.」

stage0074_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$安$$
「Where on earth are you off to!?」

stage0074_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$つばさ$$
「That man...I'm going to find Kenzo.」

stage0074_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Yeah, that's right.
　That man's still hiding something.」

stage0074_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$つばさ$$
「If I'm going to die to settle things,
　it'll be after I get that out of him.」

stage0074_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Don't you worry.
　I don't plan on dying that easily either.」

stage0074_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$つばさ$$
「You lot taught me the value
　of struggling to the very end.」

stage0074_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Of course we will.
　Next time's sure to be the first
　and last Kabuto family reunion.」

stage0074_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$つばさ$$
「$$クロス$$, $$安$$, $$ジャンゴ$$, $$先生$$, $$お菊$$...
　Sorry, but lend $$甲児$$ a hand.」

stage0074_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$お菊$$
「Please, go on your journey
　without a single worry, Ma'am.」

stage0074_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Thank you.
　Someday, I'd like to run $$くろがね屋$$
　with you all again.」

stage0074_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$隼人$$
「The proprietress carries on her own fight.
　And so do we.」

stage0074_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Still, today's battle brought
　some gains too.」

stage0074_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$シモン$$
「That the Mycenaeans see Geminis as an enemy?」

stage0074_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$オズマ$$
「That's right.
　If they meant it, they intend to break
　the Prison of Time.」

stage0074_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「But that means war with $$バアル$$.」

stage0074_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$竜馬$$
「And besides, no way in hell
　I'm relying on help from those guys.」

stage0074_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$シモン$$
「I agree.
　We'll take down Geminis ourselves,
　and stop $$エタニティ・フラット$$ ourselves too.」

stage0074_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah...
　Like hell I'd rely on those who call
　human lives meaningless.」

stage0074_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Tough luck.
　I don't much like bowing my head
　to people I hate.」

stage0074_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Especially not to a bunch who
　go around calling themselves gods.」

stage0074_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$クェス$$
「It's fine, $$ギュネイ$$.
　I don't hate that about you.」

stage0074_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I preached possibility to you.
　I don't intend to give up either.」

stage0074_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$オードリー$$
「$$マリーダ・クルス$$...」

stage0074_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$カミーユ$$...
　Did you bring that up just to
　confirm it with me?」

stage0074_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Put another way, that makes you
　part of $c too now.」

stage0074_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$クェス$$
「Cut the fake tongue-clicking.
　You're actually happy about it.」

stage0074_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$n
「Looks like they got their smiles back too.」

stage0074_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That heavy mood from before
　finally cleared up a bit.」

stage0074_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$甲児$$
「Thanks, $$號$$.

$$弁慶$$

stage0074_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$渓$$

stage0074_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:

stage0074_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$n

stage0074_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$隼人$$

stage0074_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:

stage0074_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:

stage0074_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$甲児$$
（I believe the day will come when $$シロー$$,

stage0074_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$n

stage0074_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:

stage0074_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:

stage0074_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:

stage0074_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:

stage0074_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:

stage0074_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:

stage0074_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:

stage0074_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:

stage0074_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
